title: Flux Kontext joins image generation
summary:
Flux Kontext adds voxel-art generation, sign-in gets a clearer face, and a community text adventure joins the games list.

Added `kontext` for voxel-art images at seed tier and above. It supports text prompts or an input image, with a 640-pixel maximum side length. GPT Image is now marked as requiring the flower tier.

Reworked the auth page for smaller screens, added a GitHub profile badge for signed-in users, and made its introduction respond to sign-in and sign-out. Token-validation caching was also added to reduce repeated database lookups.

Added RETIME – FABRIC OF REALITY, a screen-reader-accessible text adventure with branching choices and time-based mechanics, to the Games project list.

daily.title: Flux Kontext voxel art
daily.text: Generate voxel-art images with `model=kontext` from a text prompt or an input image. Available at seed tier and above, with a 640-pixel maximum side length. [Explore Kontext](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=kontext).
